subject: Life Skills
title: Filing a Claim Correctly
description: A quick win: understand Filing a Claim Correctly.

hook.text: Delayed reporting is the number one reason insurance claims get denied or reduced.

buildup.text: Policies require prompt notification, usually within 24 to 72 hours of an incident.

discovery.text: Document everything at the scene: photos, names, badge numbers, and a written timeline of events.

twist.text: Never admit fault at the scene. Say 'I need to speak with my insurance company first' and document.

climax.text: File the claim promptly, provide all documentation, and keep copies of every communication.

punchline.text: Report fast, document everything, admit nothing.

quiz.question: What is the most common reason insurance claims are denied?
options: The incident wasn't covered by the policy
The claim was reported too late
